name: NCAA D-I South Central Regional Cross Country Championships
where: College Station, TX · host Texas A&M
headline: NCAA D-I South Central Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 23 Arkansas won the women’s race with 51 points ahead of SMU (109) and Stephen F. Austin (113), as Texas A&M-Corpus Christi’s Elizabeth Khatevi won in 18:58.2. No. 25 Tulane beat No. 7 Arkansas 44 to 48 for the men’s title, though Arkansas freshman Nick Busienei won the race in 28:57.1, leading a 1-2 with teammate Ernest Cheruiyot.
